reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and nothing here tells me it's a real, established store. I'm not putting $360 of hardwired fixtures that an electrician has to install on a stranger's site.
objection: Is this store legit? There's no UL listing, no lumens, no wattage, no canopy or mounting details, and no height or drop, only a width. I can't hand this to my electrician or pass an inspection on that. And if it's not right, I pay return shipping on a big fragile pendant.
would_change_my_mind: A full spec sheet with UL/ETL listing, lumens, CRI, wattage, dimensions and mounting details, plus real reviews with customer photos and a verifiable company address and phone number. Free return shipping on defects or on anything that arrives damaged would help too.
